name: brt-konduktor-android
description: BRT Konduktor: the Android app (a Capacitor shell around the BRT web app)

scripts.sync: npm run prepare:www && cap sync android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
